cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

mechanism: A treats another canceled family visit as the familiar cancel-and-soften pattern, yielding help with the call while adding responsibility for the next visit.
confusable: Unlike merely delegating one call, A escalates future consequences from the repeated pattern; borrowed authority makes the difficult call easier so B remains engaged.
comparison: Shared mother and visit explanation differ from shared meal and household labor consequences.
seedUse: Use D96-b Sunday/shift/overtime/Mum/softening with S02-a a managed sequence that depends on B carrying it out.
